description: This file defines the LeaveModuleController class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It handles HTTP requests related to the leave module, specifically providing a handle() method that redirects to the default leave module path.

classes.name: LeaveModuleController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling leave module related requests, primarily redirecting users to the default leave module path.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by redirecting the user to the leave module's default page. It retrieves the default path via the home page service and performs the redirect.
